thread.title: Stock Indexes Seek Direction While Alphabet Is Little Changed After Trump Criticism

author: EdJenner
title: Stock Indexes Seek Direction While Alphabet Is Little Changed After Trump Criticism
text:
The major stock indexes faded but were trying to rebound in afternoon trading as the market slogged through a listless session.
X
Indexes erased minor losses and were marginally higher near 1:30 p.m. ET. The Nasdaq composite was up 0.1%. The S&P 500 was flat. Both indexes made record highs in early trading, although they’ve been flat most of the day.
The Nasdaq 100 also edged to a new high. The Invesco QQQ ETF ( QQQ ), which tracks the Nasdaq 100, rose 0.1%. (For updates on this story and other market coverage, check Stock Market Today .)
The Dow Jones industrial average climbed just 0.1%, even as four Dow components made new highs: Cisco Systems ( CSCO ), Apple ( AAPL ), Unitedhealth Group ( UNH ) and Visa ( V ).
Small caps lagged, with the Russell 2000 off 0.1%. The index also made a record high before dipping lower.
Market volume was tracking lower compared with the same time Monday. Declining stocks led advancers by 9-7 on the NYSE, and the ratio was almost even on the Nasdaq.
Energy, financial, automakers, logistics and some pharmaceutical stocks were among the weakest Tuesday. Electronics retail was the worst industry group after Best Buy ( BBY ) slid nearly 6% after its earnings report.
The company beat expectations and raised full-year guidance but warned of weaker Q3 adjusted operating income. Best Buy last week cleared resistance around 78 but fell to its 50-day moving average today.
U.S. oil prices fell 57 cents to $68.30 a barrel as a nearly two-week rally sputtered. Crude is hitting resistance at the late-July highs.
Alphabet ( GOOGL ) was slightly lower after President Trump accused the company’s Google business of “rigged” search results that slant news against conservatives. Trump threatened to take action. Alphabet shares are rebounding after pulling back to the 10-week moving average last week.
Align Technology ( ALGN ) tried to clear a flat base at 385.10 but fizzled. The stock is in IBD’s Sector Leaders screen.
Toronto Dominion Bank ( TD ) peeked above a 61.16 buy point but reversed. The bank reports earnings Thursday before the market’s open. Eaton ( ETN ) was stalled at its 83.73 buy point and volume was about one-third less than normal.
Kornit Digital ( KRNT ) looked better but was trading below a 20.10 buy point after paring gains. Volume was tracking nearly seven times more than average.
